item.title: Version 1.1.6 (macOS)
item.description:
v1.1.6 — Smarter PDF downloads

  • Direct PDF URLs: real title is now extracted from PDF metadata, editable in the dialog, and matched against existing papers
  • Tag-aware subfolder suggestion: defaults to where most papers under the current tag already live
  • Background downloads: window hides immediately on Download; progress shows in the sidebar footer
  • Parallel downloads queue with combined progress bar

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
v1.1.0 — Auto-Update System

  • Auto-update checking via Sparkle 2
  • Update notification badge on settings icon
  • About section in Settings with version info
  • PDF viewer right-click context menu
  • Fix Google/GitHub OAuth in release builds
  • DMG installer with drag-to-Applications
